title: US halts flights at busy East Coast airports, says fiber line cut at construction site - Reuters
content:
# 国际新闻英文阅读


## 新闻标题
**US halts flights at busy East Coast airports, says fiber line cut at construction site**
（美国东海岸繁忙机场航班暂停，称施工工地光纤线路被切断）

## 新闻背景
近日，美国东海岸多个繁忙机场的航班被迫暂停。据路透社报道，事故原因是施工工地的一条光纤线路被切断，导致航空通信系统出现故障。受影响的机场可能包括纽约、华盛顿等主要城市的枢纽机场。此类事件凸显了关键基础设施对航空安全运营的重要性，也引发了公众对施工安全管理与航空通信系统脆弱性的关注。

## 英文原文
US halts flights at busy East Coast airports, says fiber line cut at construction site

*(Source: Reuters)*

> 注：由于原始链接为 Google News RSS 聚合链接，无法直接抓取完整正文。以下为基于标题和新闻背景整理的模拟新闻正文，供英语学习使用。

**WASHINGTON, Oct. 15 (Reuters)** — U.S. aviation authorities halted flights at several busy airports along the East Coast on Tuesday after a fiber optic line was accidentally cut at a construction site, officials said.

The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said the damaged fiber line disrupted a critical communication system used to manage air traffic, forcing the agency to ground flights at major hubs including airports in the New York and Washington metropolitan areas.

"We are working closely with our partners to restore the system as quickly as possible," an FAA spokesperson said in a statement. "The safety of passengers remains our top priority."

The outage caused widespread delays and cancellations, stranding thousands of travelers. Airlines advised passengers to check flight status before heading to the airport.

Authorities said a construction crew had been working in the area when the fiber line was severed. The incident is under investigation, and officials have not yet announced when normal operations will resume.

## 高频词汇学习

1. **halt** [hɔːlt]
   - v. 使暂停，使停止
   - 原文例句：*US halts flights at busy East Coast airports.*
   - 新闻语境用法：常用于报道政府或机构突然叫停某项活动，如"halt flights/traffic/operations"，语气比"stop"更正式。

2. **fiber optic line** [ˈfaɪbər ˈɒptɪk laɪn]
   - n. 光纤线路
   - 原文例句：*A fiber optic line was accidentally cut at a construction site.*
   - 新闻语境用法：涉及通信、网络基础设施报道时的核心术语，常与"cut/damage/disrupt"搭配。

3. **aviation** [ˌeɪviˈeɪʃn]
   - n. 航空；航空业
   - 原文例句：*U.S. aviation authorities halted flights...*
   - 新闻语境用法：新闻中常见搭配有"aviation authorities"（航空管理部门）、"aviation industry"（航空业）、"civil aviation"（民航）。

4. **disrupt** [dɪsˈrʌpt]
   - v. 扰乱，中断
   - 原文例句：*The damaged fiber line disrupted a critical communication system.*
   - 新闻语境用法：高频新闻动词，常用于描述对系统、服务、秩序造成的干扰，如"disrupt traffic/services/operations"。

5. **ground** [ɡraʊnd]
   - v. 使（飞机）停飞
   - 原文例句：*...forcing the agency to ground flights at major hubs.*
   - 新闻语境用法：航空新闻专用动词，如"ground all flights"（停飞所有航班），也可用于被动语态"flights were grounded"。

6. **hub** [hʌb]
   - n. 枢纽（机场、城市等）
   - 原文例句：*...at major hubs including airports in the New York and Washington metropolitan areas.*
   - 新闻语境用法：常指交通枢纽，如"airline hub"（航空枢纽）、"transport hub"（交通枢纽）。

7. **outage** [ˈaʊtɪdʒ]
   - n. （电力、通信等的）中断，停运
   - 原文例句：*The outage caused widespread delays and cancellations.*
   - 新闻语境用法：常用于报道电力中断（power outage）、网络中断（network outage）等，是基础设施类新闻的高频词。

8. **strand** [strænd]
   - v. 使滞留，使困于某处
   - 原文例句：*...stranding thousands of travelers.*
   - 新闻语境用法：常用于报道自然灾害或突发事件导致旅客滞留，如"passengers were stranded at the airport"。

9. **sever** [ˈsevər]
   - v. 切断，割断
   - 原文例句：*A construction crew had been working in the area when the fiber line was severed.*
   - 新闻语境用法：比"cut"更正式，常用于被动语态，如"the line was severed"，也用于抽象意义如"sever ties/diplomatic relations"（断绝关系）。

10. **resume** [rɪˈzjuːm]
    - v. 恢复，重新开始
    - 原文例句：*Officials have not yet announced when normal operations will resume.*
    - 新闻语境用法：报道中断事件后续时的高频词，如"resume operations/service/talks"（恢复运营/服务/谈判）。

## 重点表达解析

1. **halt flights**
   - 含义：暂停/停止航班
   - 使用场景：航空新闻中描述因天气、故障、安全等原因暂停航班运营
   - 例句：*The airline was forced to halt flights due to the severe storm.*

2. **top priority**
   - 含义：首要任务，重中之重
   - 使用场景：官方声明中强调某件事最重要，常见于政府、机构发言人的表态
   - 例句：*The safety of passengers remains our top priority.*

3. **under investigation**
   - 含义：正在调查中
   - 使用场景：新闻报道中表示事件原因尚未查明，常用于事故、犯罪等报道
   - 例句：*The incident is under investigation, and officials have not yet announced the cause.*

4. **widespread delays and cancellations**
   - 含义：大范围的延误和取消
   - 使用场景：交通、航空新闻中描述突发事件对出行造成的影响
   - 例句：*The snowstorm caused widespread delays and cancellations across the region.*

5. **work closely with**
   - 含义：与……密切合作
   - 使用场景：官方声明中表示与其他机构协调配合，常见于应急响应报道
   - 例句：*We are working closely with our partners to restore the system.*

## 阅读理解练习

**1. What caused the flight halt at East Coast airports?**

A. A severe snowstorm
B. A fiber optic line cut at a construction site
C. A cyberattack on the FAA system

答案：B

**2. According to the article, what did the FAA say about the situation?**

A. The system will never be restored
B. Passenger safety remains the top priority
C. The construction crew will be arrested

答案：B

**3. What advice did airlines give to passengers?**

A. To cancel their travel plans
B. To check flight status before going to the airport
C. To take trains instead of flights

答案：B
